response.justification: The candidate is a broadly experienced senior developer with strong testing culture and some high-scale systems exposure, but falls well short of the core requirements: professional C++ experience amounts to roughly seven months (versus 8 years required), most work is in TypeScript/Node.js and DLang, and there is no demonstrated formal technical-leadership or people-mentoring track record at the level this role demands. Cloud infrastructure experience is present but application-level rather than platform/compute architecture.
strengths: High-throughput distributed systems experience at Dunnhumby/Sociomantic (millions of requests per second, low-latency async I/O)
Strong engineering practices: TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development, plus workshop creation and community teaching
Long, self-driven ownership of GISCollective, showing ability to drive an ambiguous project end-to-end on Kubernetes
concerns: C++ experience (~7 months professional) is far below the required 8 years
No formal technical-leadership role mentoring cloud/DevOps engineers or setting cross-team technical strategy
Recent career trajectory is full-stack product/web work, not cloud compute platforms or infrastructure architecture

key_factors.factor: Lack of formal technical leadership experience
